scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run db:generate -w apps/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
